description: Harness workspace orientation, owned conversation recording and explicit execution continuation.

hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command '$cursor = Get-Item -LiteralPath .; $root = '"'"''"'"'; while ($null -ne $cursor) { $marker = Join-Path $cursor.FullName '"'"'.harness/workspace.json'"'"'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $marker) { $root = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $marker -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).PrimaryRoot; break }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $cursor.FullName '"'"'.agents/skills/harness/scripts/Invoke-HarnessCodexHook.ps1'"'"')) { $root = $cursor.FullName; break }; $cursor = $cursor.Parent }; if ($root) { & (Join-Path $root '"'"'.agents/skills/harness/scripts/Invoke-HarnessCodexHook.ps1'"'"') }'
hooks.commandWindows: pwsh.exe -NoProfile -Command "$cursor = Get-Item -LiteralPath .; $root = ''; while ($null -ne $cursor) { $marker = Join-Path $cursor.FullName '.harness/workspace.json'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $marker) { $root = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $marker -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).PrimaryRoot; break }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $cursor.FullName '.agents/skills/harness/scripts/Invoke-HarnessCodexHook.ps1')) { $root = $cursor.FullName; break }; $cursor = $cursor.Parent }; if ($root) { & (Join-Path $root '.agents/skills/harness/scripts/Invoke-HarnessCodexHook.ps1') }"
